$note: S7 split zero-web out of zero-api. This vercel.json now describes an API-only deployment. The SPA (dist/web/) belongs in a separate Vercel project pointed at web/ and configured with VITE_API_BASE_URL for the API origin. If you need the old combined deploy, add: { "src": "/(.*)", "dest": "dist/web/$1" } and rebuild dist/web/ inside this project.
